title: Simple critical zeros and distinct zeros of the Riemann zeta function in short intervals
summary: Recently, on the non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function, it is obtained by Alpöge and Furman that more than 67.25% of the zeros are simple and on the critical line, and more than 83.62% are distinct. Later, Lamzouri gave a different and more direct proof. In this article, we will use the method of Lamzouri to give lower bounds on the number of the non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function in short intervals.
